title: Taking a loan

items.title: The amount borrowed is stated
items.look_for: The sanctioned amount, in digits and words
items.why_it_matters: The amount disbursed is sometimes less than the amount sanctioned
items.question_to_ask: How much will actually reach my account?

items.title: The interest rate and its type are stated
items.look_for: A rate, and whether it is fixed or floating
items.why_it_matters: A floating rate can raise your instalment without warning
items.question_to_ask: Is this rate fixed or floating, and what is it linked to?

items.title: The total amount repayable is stated
items.look_for: The sum of all instalments over the full term
items.why_it_matters: The total is the number that tells you what the loan costs
items.question_to_ask: What is the total I will have repaid by the end?

items.title: All fees and charges are listed
items.look_for: Processing fee, documentation charges, insurance and any deduction at disbursal
items.why_it_matters: Fees deducted upfront reduce what you receive
items.question_to_ask: What is deducted before the money reaches me?

items.title: The repayment schedule is set out
items.look_for: Instalment amount, due date and number of instalments
items.why_it_matters: It is what you have to plan your month around
items.question_to_ask: What is the instalment and which date is it due?

items.title: Prepayment terms are stated
items.look_for: Whether you may repay early, and any charge for doing so
items.why_it_matters: A prepayment penalty can lock you into a costly loan
items.question_to_ask: Can I repay early, and what would that cost?

items.title: Late payment consequences are stated
items.look_for: Penal interest, bounce charges and how they are calculated
items.why_it_matters: Penalties compound quickly on a missed instalment
items.question_to_ask: What happens if an instalment is a few days late?

items.title: Any security or guarantee is described
items.look_for: Assets pledged, or a guarantor's obligations
items.why_it_matters: A guarantor can be pursued for the whole amount
items.question_to_ask: What is pledged, and what would a guarantor be liable for?

items.title: What counts as default is defined
items.look_for: Events that let the lender demand the whole balance at once
items.why_it_matters: A broad default clause can be triggered by a minor lapse
items.question_to_ask: What exactly counts as a default?

items.title: Recovery practice is addressed
items.look_for: How and when the lender may contact you about arrears
items.why_it_matters: It sets a written standard you can point to
items.question_to_ask: How will you contact me if a payment is missed?

items.title: Any bundled insurance is optional and priced
items.look_for: An insurance premium added to the loan, and whether it is optional
items.why_it_matters: Bundled cover is often added to the borrowed amount and charged interest
items.question_to_ask: Is this insurance optional, and what does it add to my cost?

items.title: You can get a statement of account
items.look_for: A right to a statement or a foreclosure letter on request
items.why_it_matters: You need it to check the balance and to close the loan
items.question_to_ask: How do I get a statement of account?

items.title: A grievance route is given
items.look_for: A grievance officer, an address or an escalation path
items.why_it_matters: It is the first step if something goes wrong
items.question_to_ask: Who do I contact if I have a complaint?

suggested_questions: What is the total amount I will repay?
Can I repay the loan early, and what does that cost?
What happens if I miss an instalment?
What fees are deducted before the money reaches me?
Is the interest rate fixed or floating?

scenarios.title: I repay the whole loan early
I lose my income for three months

facts_to_have_ready: The amount sanctioned and the amount actually received
The date of disbursal and the instalment due date
Instalments paid so far, with dates
Any charges deducted, with the statement showing them
documents_to_bring: The loan agreement and the sanction letter
Bank statements showing disbursal and instalments
Any notice you have received about arrears
